shared_elements: row of repeated vertical strokes / comb-like hatched band
small schematic animal figures with legs and heads in outline
justification: Both surfaces show profile quadrupeds distributed in loose superimposed registers, and both contain a long horizontal element crossed by a row of repeated short strokes (a hatched band in A, crewed hulls in B), but this is a generic correspondence. A is dominated by heavy modelled relief animals (a large predator head-down, birds, a crouching figure, a serpentine form) with no boats, while B is entirely linear schematic engraving dominated by ships with upturned prows, which have no counterpart in A.
